threads.body: Compare against the PR's base branch rather than always against `main`. CI also runs for human-authored backports targeting `package-release/...`; with this ref, every API added after that release branch fork appears to have been removed (for example, current `main` exports `LocalAgentInvocation` and `RemoteAgentInvocation`, while the existing 1.1bx release branch does not), so an unrelated backport will fail this check. GitHub supplies `GITHUB_BASE_REF` for PR runs, while local runs can retain `main` as the default.
